name: AI Findy

sources.title: AIFINDY homepage - Spanish-language free AI tools directory, updated daily
Publica tu IA en AIFINDY - free listing plus Basic 49€/mo and Business 149€/mo promotion plans

requirements: AI tools directory — submission page is in Spanish ('Publica tu IA en AIFINDY')
Free listing includes a card ('ficha') with description, web link, price, and tags
Listings do not expire ('los listings no caducan')
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, price, and tags
Spanish-language copy likely preferred — the directory audience is Spanish-speaking
Contact email: imperiallifegroup@gmail.com (published on the page) or via /contacto
workflow: Go to https://aifindy.com/contacto/publica-tu-ia-en-aifindy ('Publicar nueva IA' in the footer)
Choose the free 'Publica tu IA en AIFINDY' option — card with description, web link, price, tags

Optionally pick Basic Plan (49€/month or 199€/year) for top category positions, or Business Plan (149€/month or 999€/year) adding verification, a completed full listing, a monthly blog post and social posts
Submit via the contact path and wait for the listing to appear in the directory
watchFor: No visible self-serve form fields on the publish page — the flow appears contact-driven; the exact submission mechanism is unclear
Paid plans are recurring subscriptions (monthly/yearly), not one-time
Audience claims (50k daily page views, 150k monthly uniques) are self-reported Google Analytics figures
All copy is Spanish — submission and support are in Spanish
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the directory (directorio en galería/lista) under its categories with a ficha containing description, link, price and tags
unknowns: Exact submission form/flow (the page describes plans but the entry mechanism is not rendered)
Whether the listing link is dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
